title: Sorting a table
description:
Sort table rows when a column header is clicked, the way `ImGuiTableSortSpecs` asks you to.

```
click Name   -> sorted by name ascending
click Name   -> descending
click Level  -> level ascending, equal levels by name
```
hints: In the comparator, for each spec compare that column; return as soon as one differs, flipping the result for descending (lesson 3.03).
`ImGui::TableGetSortSpecs()` gives `SpecsDirty`; sort and set it to false.
requirements: Rows of `{name, level, hp}`; sort specs are a list of `(column, ascending)`, the first being most important.
Use one `std::stable_sort` with a comparator that walks the specs.
Sort only when the specs change (a dirty flag), not every frame.
stretch: Shift+click adds a second sort column.
